claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission has a two-hour launch window opening at 6:24 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II launch window is 6:24 p.m. – 8:24 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II launch will take place from Launch Pad 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day crewed mission.
The Artemis II mission will orbit the Moon.
The Artemis II mission marks the first crewed mission to orbit the Moon in over 50 years.
Live coverage of the Artemis II launch starts at 10 a.m. ET on floridatoday.com/space and NASA+ / YouTube.
There is currently an 80% chance of favorable weather for the Artemis II launch.
If the Artemis II launch does not occur on April 1, the next available launch window is available through April 9.
There is another Artemis II launch opportunity on April 30.
